papers.title: Two-Stage Revision Protocol in Multidrug Resistant Periprosthetic Infection Following Total Hip Arthroplasty Using a Long Interval Between Stages

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论全髋关节置换术后感染的临床处理方案，未涉及任何生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is purely clinical on periprosthetic joint infection management; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨多药耐药假体周围感染二期翻修术的疗效及最佳间隔时间。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析采用长间隔二期翻修方案治疗多药耐药感染的患者数据。
summary_zh.result: 长间隔二期翻修可有效控制感染，但并发症发生率较高。
summary_zh.validation: 回顾性临床病例分析，无生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the efficacy of a two-stage revision protocol with a long interval for managing multidrug-resistant periprosthetic joint infections after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis was conducted on patients who underwent a two-stage revision with an extended interval between stages for multidrug-resistant infections.
summary_en.result: The long-interval two-stage revision effectively controlled infection but was associated with a high complication rate.
summary_en.validation: The study is a retrospective clinical case series without any biomechanical or finite element validation.
